verdict.rationale: Salesforce Sales Cloud markets pipeline visibility, forecasting, and lead-scoring dashboards (salesforce-docs-3, salesforce-docs-16, salesforce-docs-20, salesforce-docs-10), which implies native reporting/dashboard capability without spreadsheet export, but no evidence describes the actual report-builder/dashboard tool, customization options, or activity-tracking reports in depth, nor any hands-on account of building reports.
